parse_voc_xml_annotations: parse a PASCAL VOC XML annotation file and extract object names, poses, and bounding boxes
compute_voc_ap_from_precision_recall: compute the VOC average precision from precision and recall arrays using the 11-point or interpolated method
run_voc_evaluation: run PASCAL VOC evaluation to compute recall, precision, and AP for object detection results
evaluate_detections_with_iou_threshold: evaluate object detection results against ground truth annotations using a configurable IoU overlap threshold
compute_voc07_11point_ap: compute the VOC 2007 11-point average precision metric from precision and recall curves
